$comment: Hand-written. The structure of the slide, not its implementation: roles, repetition and arity only. No pixels, no colour, no copy — those live in template.html (geometry, measured) and in the shell (type scale, palette). If this file and template.html disagree about what a region is FOR, this file wins and the template is wrong.
approvalNote: UNAPPROVED. Traced and rendered, not yet reviewed by a human against ref.png. Nothing may generate from this spec until approvedBy is set — a spec nobody read is worse than no spec, because it looks reviewed.

regions.note: The subject, not the argument. Ranked above the second label by colour, not size.
Carries the action title. Two to three lines; at one line the gap above the second label opens up and the slide reads unfinished.
Quieter second label naming the method. Optional — omit and the numeral row moves up to meet the headline.

children.note: Two digits. The focal element: it crosses the ground boundary and must not be shortened to one digit or moved fully into either ground.

grounds.note: A partial-height ground change, not two slides. The enumeration's ordinal row straddles the split; that crossing is the composition. Removing the split turns this into columns-v5, which is the template this one exists to replace.

invariants: The ordinal row crosses the ground boundary. A template where the numerals sit entirely above or entirely below it is a different composition and needs a different id.
Ordinals are Regular weight, not Thin. The kit's .hero-num defaults to weight 100; the source deck does not.
Arity 3 or 4. At 5 the columns fall under the measured body width and the titles start wrapping to three lines.
The two labels are ranked by colour (orange lead, navy follow). Ranking them by size instead collapses the tier.
